verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration-services firm. Its only on-topic claim is that employers can 'run multiple cases in parallel with clean workflows, SLAs, and status dashboards', which is service-side parallel case handling plus multi-case visibility, not user-executed bulk actions. The probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec, so there is no evidence of programmatic or AI-driven batch operations. Missing for 10: user-initiated bulk actions across many cases, an API or automation surface for batch operations, documentation of how bulk operations work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
